A small quest in the {wiki:Serpentine Tower|Serpentine Tower}, the sorcerers' guild of Ankrahmun. Put a pot on the fire to activate a magic field that takes you to a hidden room with a chest: inside is a {item:White Pearl}. The tower also holds an unsolved mystery involving caged creatures and levers.
Serpentine Tower, southeast of the Ankrahmun depot
Climb to the top of the tower
